task_description: Build the first visual prototype website for the Eco-Cinema Observatory - a static, scroll-driven single-page experience with immersive hero, 3D globe, tiger species profile, and scrollytelling narrative. Deployable on GitHub Pages. Light/pastel/liquid-glass aesthetic with contemplative pacing.

verification.summary: npm run build succeeds (232ms). Produces dist/index.html (10.7KB), CSS (8.3KB/2.4KB gzip), JS (656KB/181KB gzip - mostly Three.js). All 5 sections present with full content. No unit tests needed for visual prototype - verification is build success.
